name: Vampire - Move - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a legendary

results.text: With a flicker of darkness, the vampire vanishes and reappears beyond reach, leaving only a scent of decay.
A blur of crimson cloak streaks past foes, too swift for steel to find purchase.
The undead monster glides like a specter, its movement as effortless as death itself.
A gust of unnatural wind follows the vampire's passage, leaving enemies gasping in vain.
In an instant, the creature is gone—only the faintest echo of a heartbeat remains.
